answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, like a boat paying to tie up at a jetty: spawning a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes, so the attack costs real capital. A violet reputation ledger then records verified work, and only agents holding a pearl of proven history, completed jobs attested by independent peers, gain access to high-value tasks. New identities start with nothing, so flooding the network buys no influence without paying the stake and earning the record.
